scope: TC0-A rows and the G0 core-readiness rows G1 depends on, for the pure-call demo (schemas /1 and /2)

statuses.DEVELOPMENT-EVIDENCE: Retained development evidence exists for the stated scope; it is not a verdict
statuses.UNKNOWN: Required evidence is missing or incomplete
statuses.DEFERRED-TO-B-C: Belongs to a later slice; never satisfies an A row

rows.requirement: Selected Shen/process toolchain baseline and pinned source inventory
gaps: x86-64 Linux only (shen-scheme v0.26 ships one binary)
The native-host epoch (Solo5 images, C toolchain) is separate and not opened
Node and Python used by checks are whatever runs them; the flake's devShell pins them but nothing enforces its use

rows.requirement: Exact I64 values, intermediates and unsigned IDs against independently established integers, per relied-on Shen port
gaps: Finite boundary product (2908 programs per port), not all I64 pairs
Not yet bound into a registered evaluator manifest

rows.requirement: Enforced evaluator boundary: candidates cannot write protected inputs, read credentials or reach the network
gaps: Covers the candidate peer only; the regression suite runs with network and environment isolation only
CPU, memory and time are bounded by watchdogs, not the sandbox
No independent review; not a qualified isolation claim

rows.requirement: Versioned requirement ledger
gaps: Not independently reviewed
Not yet the requirement manifest of a registered TC0-A evaluator

rows.requirement: Canonical transport: decimal strings, sorted keys, escapes, duplicate-key and UTF-8 rejection, byte hashing
Reject malformed, unsupported, ill-typed, non-exhaustive/duplicate-arm and invalid-entry artifacts; caps yield ValidationLimit; invalid artifacts never execute
gaps: Invalid family is 27 named single mutations of one seed, not exhaustive invalid-program exploration
Region checks are not exercised in A (no regions)

rows.requirement: Immutable values; aliases never change
A-slice types and built-ins: Unit/Bool/I64/Bytes/TrapCode, tuples, datatypes, construct/match/project, arithmetic, comparisons, not, bytes_length/bytes_index/bytes_concat, eq
gaps: Outcome, SendResult and ReceiveResult families belong to C

rows.requirement: Strict left-to-right operand evaluation; a trapping operand prevents later operands; if/match select exactly one branch
Tail calls do not increase semantic continuation depth
gaps: Semantic continuation depth only; native stack usage is a P5 obligation

rows.requirement: Normative reference-step staging with a versioned, hashed transition catalog exercised by one-step evidence
gaps: Catalog not independently reviewed
Coverage is per named transition (112/112), not every frame/context combination

rows.requirement: Closure descriptors {code_id, captures, capture_support: []} with captures in increasing binding-ID order
Strict replay from the first slice: singleton decisions, epochs, sites, full trace and exact footers; drift fails closed
Termination on the last permitted step is Completed; a further runnable step is BudgetExhausted
Exploration identity and ExhaustiveWithinBounds claims
gaps: A has one scheduling alternative per state, so exploration is over programs (every program of grammar G up to 5 nodes), not interleavings
No property monitors yet

rows.requirement: Generated discovery of an implementation failure, typed reduction with fresh model confirmation, exact original and minimized replay
gaps: Smallest-found, not globally minimal

rows.requirement: One independently built candidate-only repair with fresh passing evidence
gaps: Repairer isolation was instruction-only (local subagent), not enforced
Repairer shares a model family with the packet author
One small, local defect

rows.requirement: Reversed-operands candidate mutant killed with the expected classification and a retained reproducer
Bad-overflow candidate mutant killed
gaps: Killed by trace divergence in the exhaustive scope; no reduced, retained reproducer yet

rows.requirement: Ignored replay-domain mismatch detected
Early-terminal contradiction detected
gaps: Scripted peer at the replay layer; a fabricated trace that also fakes every later step is out of scope by design (02 §16)

rows.requirement: Unknown-to-pass promotion rejected
gaps: Controller-level only (unknown and unresolved cleanup stop instead of pass); no registered TC0-A evaluator to test

rows.requirement: Host-time read detected
gaps: 02 §16: runtime/time mutants start in C. A has no time semantics, and the sandbox does not deny clock reads

rows.requirement: Explicit Shen model; candidate imports no Shen transitions; port agreement claims only portability
Aggregate verdicts from a versioned requirement manifest with fresh source-bound evidence
gaps: Owner-reviewed and registered under recorded waivers: instruction-only repairer isolation, current scopes and a trusted-local evaluator
The ledger records evidence, not verdicts; the registered gate issues them

rows.requirement: User effects and handlers
Tasks, scopes, channels, cancellation, resources and virtual time
